name: Similar Triangles
overview: Equilateral triangles are drawn on the three sides of a right angled triangle. Further, in triangles ABC and DEC, corresponding angles Basic proportionality are equal. Similar triangles ACD and ABE A are constructed on sides AC and AB.

saq.question: Explain corresponding and proportion with reference to Similar Triangles.
saq.answer: Similarly, in geometry, two polygons of the same number of sides are similar if their corresponding angles are equal and their corresponding sides are in the same ratio or proportion.

saq.question: Explain corresponding and building with reference to Similar Triangles.
saq.answer: A polygon in which all sides and angles are equal is called a regular polygon. The ratio of the corresponding sides is referred to as scale or scale factor (or) representative factor). In real life, blue prints for the construction of a building are prepared using a suitable scalefactor.

saq.answer: Give some more examples from your daily life where scale factor is used. All regular polygons having the same number of sides are always similar. For example, all squares are similar, all equilateral triangles are similar and so on.
